# Source Code Viewer

Use installed `@agentcraft/source-code`; import `SourceCodeViewer` and
`SourceCodeViewerProps`. Read the [canonical guide](../../../libraries/source-code/docs/skills/source-code.md)
for the host boundary, failure behavior and preserved safety contract.
This entry contains no runtime and grants no source access.
